title: The Bomb Has Been Planted
blurb: Forty seconds on the clock, and every heart rate in the server climbs at once. Counter-Strike's announcement is a masterclass in tension, because the sentence itself is calm and administrative while the round has just entered its terminal phase whatever anybody had planned. Twenty-five years of clutches, defuses and one-second losses live inside it. The meme usage maps it onto any point of no return — the message sent, the oven left on, the decision made out loud in front of witnesses. From here, everything is consequences.
